mapper.sql: SELECT v.*, w.name AS warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, pu.nickname AS pick_by_name, COALESCE(t.delivery_count, 0) AS delivery_count, COALESCE(t.total_qty, 0) AS total_qty FROM scm_wave v JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = v.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pu.id = v.pick_by LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.wave_id, COUNT(DISTINCT d.id) AS delivery_count, SUM(i.qty) AS total_qty FROM scm_delivery d JOIN scm_delivery_item i ON i.delivery_id = d.id WHERE d.wave_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY d.wave_id ) t ON t.wave_id = v.id
mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS "deliveryId", d.delivery_no AS "deliveryNo", c.name AS "customerName", p.delivery_item_id AS "deliveryItemId", p.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", m.spec AS "spec", m.unit AS "unit", m.serial_enabled AS "serialEnabled", p.location_id AS "locationId", l.code AS "locationCode", l.zone AS "zone", p.batch_no AS "batchNo", b.expiry_date AS "expiryDate", p.qty AS "qty" FROM scm_delivery d JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = d.customer_id JOIN scm_delivery_pick p ON p.delivery_id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = p.material_id LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = p.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_batch b ON b.material_id = p.material_id AND b.batch_no = p.batch_no AND p.batch_no <> '' WHERE d.wave_id = #{waveId} AND d.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY CASE WHEN l.id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, l.zone, l.sort, l.code, m.code, p.batch_no, d.delivery_no

SELECT d.delivery_no AS "deliveryNo", m.code AS "materialCode", m.name AS "materialName", m.unit AS "unit", i.qty AS "qty", COALESCE(s.suggested, 0) AS "suggested" FROM scm_delivery d JOIN scm_delivery_item i ON i.delivery_id = d.id JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT delivery_item_id, SUM(qty) AS suggested FROM scm_delivery_pick GROUP BY delivery_item_id ) s ON s.delivery_item_id = i.id WHERE d.wave_id = #{waveId} AND d.status = 'PENDING' AND COALESCE(s.suggested, 0) < i.qty ORDER BY d.delivery_no, m.code
